critical_code_review_comments: routes/factoring.py line 771 uses __import__('datetime').timedelta — works but ugly; prefer 'from datetime import timedelta' at top of file (cosmetic).

_compare_cost ABL math models monthly interest on outstanding AR (terms/30) — correctly results in ABL being cheapest for short-payment-term scenarios, which matches the playbook intent. Document the assumption in API docstring.
factoring.py — outreach_template hardcodes margin estimates ($215 / $230 per load) inside the template; consider exposing via OutreachGenerateIn so brokers with different unit economics can override.

ApplicationIn payload schema requires factor_id+status on PUT — that's an idempotent upsert payload, fine. But there is no separate 'patch status only' endpoint; UI must always send full payload on edit. Minor UX consideration if E1 adds row-level status quick-edits later.
AI polish returns ai_polished=false silently on quota/network error — verified working. Good defensive coding.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST application (deleted in-test) + 1 TEST submission (deleted in-test) + 1 UI submission UI-TEST-001 (deleted via API cleanup).
